title: Detailed cookie
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Cookie shadow / glow -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="52" r="34" fill="#3a2a10" opacity="0.4"/>
  
  <!-- Cookie base - main body -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="33" fill="#d4943a"/>
  
  <!-- Cookie lighter inner area for depth -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="28" fill="#e8aa50"/>
  
  <!-- Cookie highlight edge -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="33" fill="none" stroke="#f0c070" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- Bumpy cookie edge details -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="35" r="5" fill="#d4943a"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="52" r="5" fill="#d4943a"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="70" r="5" fill="#d4943a"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="81" r="5" fill="#d4943a"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="70" r="5" fill="#d4943a"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="52" r="5" fill="#d4943a"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="35" r="5" fill="#d4943a"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="19" r="5" fill="#d4943a"/>
  
  <!-- Edge highlights on bumps -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="34" r="3" fill="#e8aa50" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="51" r="3" fill="#e8aa50" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="69" r="3" fill="#e8aa50" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="80" r="3" fill="#e8aa50" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="69" r="3" fill="#e8aa50" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="51" r="3" fill="#e8aa50" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="34" r="3" fill="#e8aa50" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="18" r="3" fill="#e8aa50" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- Chocolate chips - dark brown with warm highlights (not black) -->
  <!-- Chip 1 - top left -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="35" rx="7" ry="6" fill="#4a2810" transform="rotate(-15 38 35)"/>
  <ellipse cx="37" cy="33" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#6b3d1a" transform="rotate(-15 37 33)"/>
  
  <!-- Chip 2 - top center -->
  <ellipse cx="55" cy="30" rx="6" ry="7" fill="#4a2810" transform="rotate(20 55 30)"/>
  <ellipse cx="54" cy="28" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#6b3d1a" transform="rotate(20 54 28)"/>
  
  <!-- Chip 3 - top right -->
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="38" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#4a2810" transform="rotate(10 68 38)"/>
  <ellipse cx="69" cy="36" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#6b3d1a" transform="rotate(10 69 36)"/>
  
  <!-- Chip 4 - left middle -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="50" rx="6" ry="7" fill="#4a2810" transform="rotate(-25 32 50)"/>
  <ellipse cx="31" cy="48" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#6b3d1a" transform="rotate(-25 31 48)"/>
  
  <!-- Chip 5 - center -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="7" ry="6" fill="#4a2810" transform="rotate(5 50 50)"/>
  <ellipse cx="49" cy="48" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#6b3d1a" transform="rotate(5 49 48)"/>
  
  <!-- Chip 6 - right middle -->
  <ellipse cx="67" cy="50" rx="6" ry="7" fill="#4a2810" transform="rotate(30 67 50)"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="48" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#6b3d1a" transform="rotate(30 68 48)"/>
  
  <!-- Chip 7 - bottom left -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="65" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#4a2810" transform="rotate(-10 40 65)"/>
  <ellipse cx="39" cy="63" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#6b3d1a" transform="rotate(-10 39 63)"/>
  
  <!-- Chip 8 - bottom center -->
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="68" rx="6" ry="6" fill="#4a2810" transform="rotate(15 52 68)"/>
  <ellipse cx="51" cy="66" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#6b3d1a" transform="rotate(15 51 66)"/>
  
  <!-- Chip 9 - bottom right -->
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="63" rx="6" ry="7" fill="#4a2810" transform="rotate(-20 64 63)"/>
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="61" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#6b3d1a" transform="rotate(-20 65 61)"/>
  
  <!-- Small crumb details -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="42" r="1.5" fill="#c08830" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="58" r="1.5" fill="#c08830" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="60" r="1.5" fill="#c08830" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="40" r="1.5" fill="#c08830" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- Tiny sparkle highlights -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="28" r="1.5" fill="#f5d090" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="72" r="1.5" fill="#f5d090" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="25" cy="45" r="1.5" fill="#f5d090" opacity="0.5"/>
</svg>
